places.description: allowedModels + gateRegex enforced by the gate transition. Must hold exactly one token before arming.

description: Ask in natural language what a place holds. An agent reads the request and picks a strategy (count or sample); a DETERMINISTIC pipeline then calls the master API and composes the reply, so every number and sample is a measured fact the model cannot author. Read-only by construction. Policy-gated: reading another model's tokens is disclosure, so out-of-scope targets are refused before anything is read.

entry.howToUse: Write ONE token to p-inspector-task with flat string fields {requestId, request} and optionally {targetModel, place}. Then await a token in p-inspector-output whose requestId equals yours. The reply carries status (done|refused|unsupported|failed), strategy (count|sample), count, up to sample1..sample3 and a one-line message. All values are measured by the pipeline.

place.description: Optional if the request text names it

request.description: Plain English, e.g. how many tokens are in p-fj-shipped in academy

requestId.description: Your correlation id, echoed on the reply

targetModel.description: Optional if the request text names it

name: place-inspector

personas.description: Reads one request and writes one structured intent. It has rw only: it cannot call HTTP, sample, count or report numbers.
personas.name: inspector
